apps.name: Brinkline
apps.description: Motorbike racer through five deadly domains: lava, black ice, laser-gated neon streets, acid swamp and a lightning storm. Drift and draft for boost, beat 7 rivals, win the Grand Prix and upgrade your bikes.

apps.name: Project SuperInk
apps.description: 4v4 ink-shooter in the browser: battles, story mode and online rooms.

apps.name: Krazy Kombat
apps.description: One-on-one arcade fighter: six original brawlers, specials, supers and silly finishers. Play the CPU or a friend.

apps.name: Sky Hopper
apps.description: Endless climber: bounce Pip up through crumbling sky platforms, stomp thornbugs and grab sparks.

apps.name: Block Bash Arena
apps.description: Bumper car brawl on a shrinking stage. Knock rivals off the edge, solo vs CPUs or with a friend.

apps.name: Turbo Tanks
apps.description: Tiny tanks, bouncing shells, random mazes. First to 5 vs the CPU or a friend.

apps.name: Dungeon Dash
apps.description: Quick roguelike: five rooms of random monsters, a treasure pick after each, and a boss at the bottom.

apps.name: Rhythm Rush
apps.description: Four-lane rhythm game with three original tracks. Lanes speed up as your combo grows.

apps.name: Gravity Golf
apps.description: Nine holes of mini golf in space, where every planet bends your shot.

apps.name: Zombie Hold-Out
apps.description: Wave survival shooter. Build barricades and turrets between rounds and see how long you last.

apps.name: Word Blitz
apps.description: 60-second word hunt on a 4x4 letter grid. Chain neighbouring tiles to spell words.

apps.name: Orca
apps.description: Friendly AI chat and coding assistant, built into the launcher.

apps.name: Stellar Forge
apps.description: Space sandbox with up to 777,000 objects under real gravity. Summon galaxies, flip gravity, set off supernovas and stir it all with gravity brushes.

apps.name: Neon Drift
apps.description: Arcade dodger: steer through a neon storm, grab orbs, chase your best score.

apps.name: Fusion
apps.description: Swipe to fuse matching orbs. Reach 2048 without filling the board.

apps.name: Snake
apps.description: Classic snake with picks for map size, speed and how many apples. Smooth moves and a best score per setup.
apps.label: LTZ

apps.name: Stackfall
apps.description: Falling-block puzzler: rotate, drop and clear lines as the speed climbs. Pixel or smooth style, with retro sound.
apps.label: LTZ

apps.name: Tiny Roads
apps.description: Calm road-building puzzler: link colored houses to their matching stations, add bridges, lights and motorways, and keep traffic flowing week after week.
apps.label: LTZ

apps.name: Grid Pop
apps.description: Drag blocks onto an 8x8 grid and clear full rows and columns. Chain clears for combos and chase your best score.
apps.label: LTZ

apps.name: Money Clicker
apps.description: Idle clicker: tap the bill to earn cash, buy coin jars, lemonade stands and real estate, unlock upgrades and achievements, and watch the money roll in.
apps.label: LTZ

apps.name: Dino Game
apps.description: Endless runner: help Rex dash across the desert, jumping thornblooms and boulders and ducking pterodactyls. Gets faster the longer you last.

apps.name: Soundbloom
apps.description: Music playground: make full songs on a grid, loop polyrhythm drums, jam on keys, draw your own waveforms. Share songs as links and export WAV or MIDI.

apps.name: Jot
apps.description: Quick notes that save as you type. Search everything, first line is the title.

apps.name: Focus
apps.description: Pomodoro timer with breaks, a chime, and a count of today's sessions.

apps.name: Comet
apps.description: Built-in web browser with tabs, an address bar and a home page of shortcuts. Sites that refuse to load inside other pages open in a new tab.

apps.name: Star Swarm
apps.description: Space shooter: dodge swarms that swoop in waves, grab gun upgrades and shields, and take down a boss every fifth wave.

apps.name: Paddle Panic
apps.description: Brick breaker with new layouts every level, tough bricks, and power-ups: wide paddle, multi-ball, slow-mo and lasers.

apps.name: Fuse Field
apps.description: Logic puzzle: clear the field without setting off a fuse. Numbers tell you how many fuses touch each tile. Three sizes and best times.

apps.name: Sudoku
apps.description: Fresh number puzzles in four levels, with notes, hints, undo and mistake checking. Your game saves as you go.

apps.name: Mind Match
apps.description: Flip cards and find the pairs in as few moves as you can. 12, 20 or 30 cards.

apps.name: Drop Four
apps.description: Drop discs and get four in a row before your opponent. Three CPU levels or two players on one screen.

apps.name: Reversi
apps.description: Classic flip-the-discs board game on an 8x8 board. Play a corner-hungry CPU or a friend.

apps.name: Calc
apps.description: Calculator with history, plus a unit converter for length, weight, temperature, speed, data and more.

apps.name: Tasks
apps.description: To-do lists that save as you go: several lists, stars, drag to reorder and a progress bar.

apps.name: Decider
apps.description: Can’t choose? Flip a coin, roll dice, spin a wheel of your own options, pick a number or split people into teams.

apps.name: Sketch
apps.description: Drawing pad with pen, marker, spray, fill, shapes, undo and PNG export. Your page is kept between visits.

apps.name: Keystorm
apps.description: Typing speed test: timed or word-count runs, punctuation and numbers modes, live WPM and a speed chart.

apps.name: Math Sprint
apps.description: Quick-fire mental maths against the clock. Pick +, −, ×, ÷ and a level; questions get harder as your streak grows.

apps.name: Skyhook Heist
apps.description: Grapple-swing between rooftops at night, grab loot bags, and stay out of the drone spotlights.

apps.name: Tower Rush
apps.description: Tower defense where you build the maze: place towers to stretch the monsters' path, then upgrade them for bigger waves.

apps.name: Pixel Dungeon Run
apps.description: Turn-based roguelike: every run is a new dungeon with monsters, loot, potions and a boss every fifth floor.

apps.name: Battle Arena 2P
apps.description: Sumo for blobs: shove the other player out of a shrinking ring. Two players on one screen, or play the CPU.

apps.name: Tycoon Island
apps.description: Build a tiny sandbar into a famous resort: beds bring guests, fun things draw crowds, and it keeps earning while you are away.

apps.name: Orbit Dash
apps.description: Circle a planet, hop between three orbits to grab stars and dodge rocks. Every lap gets faster.

apps.name: Lava Climb
apps.description: The lava is rising: jump up a cave of crumbling, sliding and bouncy rocks with a double jump. How high can you get?

apps.name: Bubble Burst
apps.description: Aim and bounce bubbles to make groups of three. Drop whole clusters for big points before the ceiling comes down.

apps.name: Pipe Flow
apps.description: Turn the pipes until water from the tap reaches every tile. Boards grow as you go, and your level is saved.

apps.name: Puck Clash
apps.description: Table hockey against a CPU that gets tougher every time you beat it, or two players on one screen. First to 7.

apps.name: Ski Slope
apps.description: Race down the mountain: ski through gates for combos, hit ramps for big air, and dodge the trees and rocks.

apps.name: Sky Stack
apps.description: Drop sliding floors to build the tallest tower you can. Overhangs get chopped; three perfect drops in a row widen it again.

apps.name: Road Hop
apps.description: Help Pip the bunny hop across busy roads, ride logs over rivers and dodge trains. Don't dawdle, the screen keeps moving.

apps.name: Moon Lander
apps.description: Steer and thrust a lander onto small pads without crashing. Each landing refuels you a bit, but the ground gets rougher and the wind picks up.

apps.name: Light Trails
apps.description: Ride a light bike that leaves a wall behind it and box your rival in. Two players on one screen, or take on a CPU that learns to cut you off.

apps.name: Laser Maze
apps.description: Place and flip mirrors to bounce a laser through every crystal. You only get so many mirrors, and each level is new.

apps.name: Jam Escape
apps.description: A parking-lot puzzle: slide the other cars out of the way so the red car can drive out. Every level is generated and checked for the fewest moves.

apps.name: Pixel Logic
apps.description: Picture logic puzzles: use the row and column numbers to work out which squares are filled. Four sizes, every grid new.

apps.name: Crate Push
apps.description: Push every crate onto a red spot in a warehouse. You can push but never pull. Levels are generated backwards so they are always solvable.

apps.name: Gem Swap
apps.description: Swap neighbouring gems to match three or more. Match four for line gems that blast whole rows, and hit the goal before your moves run out.

apps.name: Hex Arena
apps.description: Twin-stick survival: move with one hand, shoot with the other, and outlast waves of geometric enemies while building a score multiplier.

apps.name: Archer Duel
apps.description: Take turns firing arrows across the hills. Read the wind, aim the arc, and land a headshot. Play a CPU that gets sharper, or a friend.

apps.name: Deep Cast
apps.description: Drop a hook, steer it into fish, dodge the jellyfish, and sell your catch. Upgrade your line to reach rare glowing fish in the deep.

apps.name: Mole Mayhem
apps.description: Sixty seconds to bonk as many moles as you can. Golden moles add time, helmet moles take two hits, and never hit the bombs.

apps.name: Echo Pads
apps.description: Watch the pads play a tune, then play it back. More pads join as you go, and every fifth round you have to play it backwards.

apps.name: Checkers
apps.description: The classic board game with compulsory jumps, multi-jump chains and kings. Three CPU levels, or two players on one screen.

apps.name: Box Claim
apps.description: Take turns drawing lines between dots. Close a box to claim it and go again. Beat a CPU that won't hand you easy boxes, or a friend.

apps.name: Solitaire
apps.description: Classic patience: build each suit from Ace to King. Tap a card to send it where it fits, drag stacks, undo freely. Draw 1 or Draw 3.

apps.name: Hoop Shot
apps.description: Sixty seconds to flick as many baskets as you can. Swishes score more, streaks add time, and the hoop starts moving as you get good.

apps.name: Pin Strike
apps.description: Ten frames of bowling with real strike and spare scoring. Line up, swipe to roll, and bend your swipe to hook the ball into the pocket.
